description: Migrate all eligible users from the source environment to the target environment using the bulk endpoint.

emit.description: Optional callback invoked with structured progress events. If not provided, the method emits no events and only returns a final result. Event payloads follow a consistent shape: - ``type``: str ("started" | "progress" | "warning" | "error" | "completed") - ``step``: str logical step identifier - ``message``: str human-readable message - Additional fields depending on the step (counts, status_code, etc.)

examples.user_query: How can I migrate all users from the source environment to the target environment and track progress?

emit.message: Fetching users from the source environment

examples.notes: This call migrates all eligible users from the source to the target environment and uses the emit callback to track progress at each step.

examples.user_query: I want to migrate users but don't need progress updates. How can I do that?
examples.notes: This call migrates all eligible users without emitting progress events. Use this when you only need the final migration result.

examples.user_query: Can I monitor detailed progress while migrating users to ensure everything is working correctly?

emit.message: Submitting bulk payload to the target environment

examples.notes: This call migrates users and provides detailed progress updates, including when the bulk payload is submitted to the target environment.

description: Migrate specific users from the source environment to the target environment.

user_name_list.description: The user identifiers (email addresses) to migrate.

examples.user_query: Migrate the users john.doe@example.com and jane.smith@example.com to the target environment.
examples.notes: This call migrates the specified users from the source environment to the target environment, ensuring their roles and group memberships are mapped correctly.

examples.user_query: Transfer the users admin@example.com and support@example.com to the new Sisense instance.
examples.notes: Use this call when moving administrative and support users to a new Sisense environment while preserving their configurations.

examples.user_query: Migrate the users sales.team@example.com, marketing.lead@example.com, and hr.manager@example.com to the target environment.
examples.notes: This operation is ideal for migrating multiple department leads to the target environment in one batch.
